Company Overview
Join our innovative team at RECAP, a startup revolutionizing the real estate investment landscape. We are looking for a motivated Junior Full Stack Developer to be an integral part of our team, with opportunities for learning and growth in a dynamic environment.

Job Description
As a Junior Full Stack Developer at RECAP, you will assist in the development and maintenance of our software applications. This role is ideal for someone who has foundational knowledge in full stack development and is eager to gain hands-on experience in both front-end and back-end technologies.

Responsibilities

Assist in developing and maintaining software applications across the full stack.

Collaborate with senior developers and cross-functional teams to implement new features.

Write clean and efficient code under the guidance of senior developers.

Troubleshoot and debug applications with support from the team.

Participate in code reviews and adhere to best practices.

Continuously learn and stay updated with emerging trends and technologies in software development.

Requirements

Basic experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role through internships, academic projects, or early job experience.

Familiarity with front-end frameworks, particularly Vue.js.

Basic understanding of back-end development using PHP and Laravel.

Foundational knowledge of databases, particularly MySQL.

Understanding of software development lifecycle and best practices.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Good communication and teamwork abilities.

Qualifications

0-2 years of experience in full stack development.

Experience with front-end build tools and task runners is a plus.

Eagerness to learn modern front-end development workflows and tools.

Familiarity with cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure) is a plus.

Willingness to learn about CI/CD pipelines.

Why Join Us

Be part of a small, fast-paced team working closely with experienced developers and founders.

Significant opportunities for professional growth and development.

Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies and real-world projects.

Competitive entry-level salary with potential for growth.

How to Apply
If you are passionate about software development and eager to kick-start your career with new challenges, we invite you to join us in revolutionizing the real estate investment industry. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your qualifications and why you are a good fit for the role at RECAP.
